prompt:
[STYLE]
Edit the supplied living-room reference. Preserve its polished cute 3D cartoon style, soft fabrics, warm afternoon lighting, colors, wide composition, children and recognizable object positions.

[SCENE DESCRIPTION]
The same cozy living room: television left; blue sofa center; one child reading comfortably, another sleeping on a pillow; low foreground table, separate chair right, lamp right, right window and curtain, rear shelf and books, wall clock and leafy plants.

[TARGET VOCABULARY]
Depict the existing fifteen concepts clearly, without printing their names: sofa, television, lamp, chair, table, read, sleep, comfortable, window, curtain, shelf, book, pillow, clock, plant.

[OBJECT VISIBILITY RULES]
Preserve recognizable objects and the reading/sleeping actions. Keep the pillow under the girl's head, shelf board, window pane, curtain fabric, clock hands and plant leaves visible.

[COMPOSITION]
Keep the same camera and relative object layout. Restore naturally textured surfaces where annotations are removed; do not replace the room or add new furniture.

[CHARACTERS / ACTIONS]
Preserve both children's identities, faces, natural hands and reading/sleeping poses.

[ANNOTATION STYLE]
Remove every white vocabulary label, arrow, annotation line and doodle. Do not add any replacement annotation.

[TEXT RULES]
No text anywhere: remove vocabulary labels, incidental book-cover/spine lettering and clock numerals. Keep simple book patterns and analog clock hands/tick marks. No English, Chinese, captions or signage.

[DECORATION]
Preserve the original room decoration without adding doodles.

[NEGATIVE REQUIREMENTS]
No changed camera, changed people, extra characters, missing target objects, damaged hands, fake blank patches, labels, arrows, text, logos, watermarks, UI or panels.
refinementPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied text-free living-room base illustration. Change only the remaining incidental text: remove ALL lettering and glyph-like marks from the book held by the boy, including its front cover, back cover and spine; remove ALL lettering from the two stacked books on the foreground coffee table, and ALL rear bookshelf book-spine text and the tiny television bezel brand mark. Replace those lettered patches with uninterrupted plain colored material or simple non-letter geometric illustration patterns. The held book can keep its animal/palm-tree picture but must have NO title, typography or writing. The stacked books must have plain colored spines with no lettering. Maintain exactly the same camera, framing, warm lighting, every furniture and plant location, children's faces, hair, clothing, hands and reading/sleeping poses, textures, and image dimensions. No additional objects. No vocabulary labels, arrows, doodles, captions, words, letters, digits, logos, watermark or UI anywhere. The wall clock retains hands and simple tick marks only. This is a children's vocabulary practice base image; every visible source of written hints must be removed.
